name: James Okafor
personal_statement: I spent six years maintaining and piloting aircraft in environments where a mechanical fault meant lives lost, and five years after that building the robotic systems that inspect the places humans cannot safely reach. I have spent my career solving problems at the boundary of human and machine capability. That boundary is exactly where space operations live.
psychological_profile: Technically confident, methodical under pressure. Excels in structured problem-solving scenarios. Leadership scores above cohort average. Adapts well to ambiguity when given initial parameters. Recommended for technical mission roles.
